reviews.comment: TERRIBLE chemistry professor. There was so much homework, it is ridiculous. I had no life while taking this course and it should not have taken up that much time. Be prepared to do 20+ hours of homework for this class every week. If I was able to take another professor, I would. Almost half the class q-dropped by the end of the semester.

I personally had an easier time in this class, but showing up and paying attention in class while tedious at times helps reinforce the material. Lectures were videos online and class was purely for practice, so be ready to have to learn on your own.
Prof Williamson is awesome, but be prepared to do a ton of homework (will be helpful around exam time).

This should be an easy class if you do the homework. I didn't watch the lecture videos but instead took notes from the homework problems. This class is VERY homework-heavy. But she curves almost every exam and makes it very possible to get an A.
Overall a very nice prof, but A LOT of outside lecture work. You can learn the concepts well and get a good grade if you put the work in.

Took CHEM 120 in high school junior year, got an A+. This was meant to be a refresher before CHEM 227, and this was not it. Strugged the entire semester. There was LOADS of homework and she made everything a lot harder than it needed to be. Luckily, I kept my notes from 2019 and passed BC of that. She is an OK prof, just not for me. Clickers count!

Dr. Williamson is a great professor, the class itself is just hard. The class is by far the most amount of work I've ever had to do for a class but if you do everything she asks of you and actually study you can be very successful in this class. She curves tests and sometimes the entire course grade as well so do the work and she'll do the rest.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Williamson's class is extremely homework heavy, and if you have any other hard classes it is nearly impossible to get all the homework done. She didn't do any extra credit, so be careful with making every point count. The lectures were also problem solving sessions, so be ready to learn from outside materials rather than in class.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Williamson is great at explaining concepts. The course is pretty homework heavy, but if youve taken chem AP in high schools its not hard at all. Shes super nice and very approachable and when I went to her office hours she explained some concepts very well.

She's a great professor who clearly knows what she's talking about. Only complaint is that there is a lot of homework. Be prepared to spend upwards of 8 hours a week just completing assignments due every Tuesday and Thursday.
This class has a ridiculous amount of homework. Did fine in chem 119 but this class is exponentially harder.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Probably the hardest class I have ever taken; I had a 4.0 until this class. We had to watch a pre-lecture video every MWF, homework due 5 days of the week, including mini exams, and all the work for the lab. I probably spent 20+hrs in this class alone. If you like to learn by yourself, do NOT take her. If you like hw and busywork, take her...

She doesn't do anything beneficial in class because all you do is iclicker question that are nothing like any exam questions. Be prepared to be doing 20+ hours of chem on your own weekly due to the incessant amount of homework, mini exams, labs, and lectures you have to do on your own time. Waste of money and time.

Great prof BUT I recommend taking this class when you have an easy semester bc it is EXTREMELY homework-heavy. You have multiple problems sets due every T and TR at least (usually more but the specific days vary), four exams (your final exam replaces your lowest unit exam), and you have to watch lectures BEFORE in-person lecture. Good luck!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: you aren't allowed to use real calculators so if a ti84 is something you heavily rely on, i suggest trying a different prof. her practice exams do not really help and it is the type of course where you teach yourself.

Dr. Williamson is an amazing professor! She truly hopes the best for her students and does so many things to ensure students success. I took her for 119 and 120 and did great in both of them. There is a lot of homework, but it helps you learn. I didnt read the book, but attended all the lectures and kept up with my homework and did well!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Yes there is a lot of homework but she is some of the most forgiving and nicest profs in the whole chemistry department. She gives you grace questions on tests (can miss a question and still make a 100). Because of the clickers, you have to be in class, and its a flipped class style which means out of class lectures to watch (download recorded).

Dr. Williamson is a true gem! This class does have a considerable amount of homework (and prerecorded lectures); however, if you stay on top of your work, the tests are NOT scary at all. Dr. Williamson is fun, and really cares about her students; communicate with her! She wants you to learn and actually like chemistry!! 10/10 recommend

The way Dr. Williamson's class is formatted is that you watch lectures before class, and during the class period she works out problems from the online homework. The textbook is online and is integrated into the homework. This COVID semester may have changed things, but overall I think she handled the situation very well and it went smoothly.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: There is a lot of work for this class. That being said, if you show up and get it done, you don't have to study for anything. She builds studying into the homework. She's a really great professor and always takes time to thoroughly answer student questions, but don't expect this class to be a blowoff!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: You'll have homework due at least 4 nights a week plus lab, which TA's will grade way too harshly. You'll have to watch lecture before going to actual lecture. She'll say things like "this is college we don't offer extra credit" while my 400 level classes do. Williamson acts as if this is your only class.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Pretty cool prof. She is fair and teaches flipped classroom. Which is more work because you are expected to listen to lectures before class and then come to class ready to answer questions. Lots of homework, but if you really want to learn your material- she's the prof to take!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: A GREAT professor to take if you want a solid understanding of chemistry. She covers work that will be due the next class, so you need to work ahead. Clicker points count, so you cant miss a class, but shes really good at getting you prepared for upper level chemistry.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Williamson is a good professor if you are wanting the understand chemistry; however, if you are wanting an easy A, this is not the class for you. reviews.comment: Dr. Williamson is amazing! Her practice tests were perfect preparation for her exams! She does get a little off topic in lectures, but loves to tell stories and do demos which I think made class a little more interesting. She is super helpful during office hours and genuinely cares for her students if you show that you are putting in effort!

She rambled during lectures and either goes into too much or too little detail about things. A TON of homework, so if you miss one topic and don't understand one thing then you wont be able to progress through the homework. Her office hours were good for nothing and she seemed put out that I was there asking questions.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Expect a lot of homework from her, and it has the potential to take you a long time to finish it all if you get behind. The tests themselves aren't too hard, she gives lots of practice tests and clicker questions.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Williamson is great at explaining concepts clearly. Go to class and do ALL homework for an A. She makes it easy to successfully prepare for exams by uploading practice tests online. Her grading criteria is very clear and she provides many opportunities to succeed. Your grade will truly be determined by how much work you put in, not her grading
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Williamson was very caring and provided the most learning oppurtunities for her students as possible. With her having an injury and COVID-19, she handled it well and we even performed better on the exams. As long as you do the work, which other reviewers complain about, you will do great. She teaches the material wonderfully and understandable!

Ms. Williamson is a great teacher! Her class is quite tough. She assigns a lot of homework on Mindtap each week. She also posts lectures you must watch before attending class. I think doing these things helped in getting a good grade for the class. I sometimes skipped these and have a B. Very nice lady!!

Dr. W is very educated in her field but not as great at teaching the material. Multiple long videos to watch before class and tested with clicker Qs in class. She does provide practice exams and SI sessions are helpful. Very willing to work w you but the hw is so much and takes up a lot of time. A lot of effort is required for an A-B.

Very good professor in person, but started to assign ridiculously overwhelming loads of homework during the covid crisis and changed homework due dates so that you never really knew for sure when her work was due. She also assigns hours worth of homework the night before an exam. Again, she is fantastic to take in person!

She's really nice and a good prof. If you make the effort to understand the material and do practice tests and go to SI you'll be fine. The material can be hard to understand but she is available a lot of the time. A good amount of homework from OWL and lots of participation questions. Practice tests are helpful. This prof is a solid choice.

reviews.comment: Note: taken spring 2020, amidst the COVID19 transition (Retook class - so i was very familiar with the content) improbable if taking full class load. reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Although it's clear that Williamson knows what she is talking about, she hasn't been considerate of her students this semester. We are required to watch an hour lecture video before attending each class, where she just proceeds to do clicker questions the entire lecture instead of actually teaching. The amount of homework given is actually insane.

sweet lady but this class takes up ALOT of time. She gave us multiple (30-50 min) lectures to watch before attending actual class and spent the whole class doing clicker questions. The class starts off pretty easy but gradually gets harder and there's a lot more work in the second half of the semester. Learned more from the hw & chegg than lectures

Best prof you can take for 119. We had lectures to watch online before class which was time consuming, but helped a lot since we did a lot of clicker questions in class. She's very clear and helpful in office hours. Take GOOD notes from the notes she provides. You definitely have to study and chemistry is hard, but an A is attainable in her class.

reviews.comment: After COVID-19's online transition, she became very inconsiderate. Notes are always useless, you attend class for just Clicker questions. You basically teach yourself the material.

this semester with vickie has been different to say the least. She didn't show up to teach until after the 1st exam due to an injury and instead recorded lectures and made us watch multiple videos before lecture which takes forever. She gives SO much hw every week. The 2 grade is mostly due to her inconsiderateness post-covid and us going online.

I've always struggled with chemistry and I dropped is the semester before I took her. I decided to take her course and was so thankful I chose her. She sets the class up to where you can get half-to a whole letter grade above what your test scores are. Lots of hw and gives fill-in notes. Uses iClicker every class. DO THE PRACTICE TESTS!!!

Dr. Williamson is definitely the professor to take. She can be somewhat confusing during her lectures but overall she is the most generous professor. She truly does all she can to ensure you are in the best position to get your best grade. Chem was definitely the easiest out of all the classes I took last semester because of her. Take her.

Dr. Williamson is considered one of the easier professors because of how generous she is. She gives the students a grade calculator and gives partial credit on exams. I got a C on my first exam and was still able to get an A in the class once I stepped up my studying a bit. Know everything on the practice exams and you'll for sure get a B at least.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Williamson was a great professor! She was very sweet and provided enough lecture notes and examples to refer back to come exams. Her class website is super helpful and makes the course navigable and few of surprises. You will get feedback from every exam as a class and she lets you know what types of questions will be on the final. 10/10

Williamson is a great professor and really cares about her students. There are 4 exams, the lowest exam grade being replaced by your final exam grade. Clicker questions are helpful and counted as a grade so you need to go to class, however I found SI's the most helpful for practice questions. Practice exams are also super helpful.

Dr. Williamson is by far the best professor for chem 119 (also chem 101). This class is not an easy A, but if you do the homework and practice tests before each test it is obtainable. The exams as well as the final are pretty easy. The lectures were good and she gives clicker points so make sure to show up to class. Take Dr. Williamson!

An amazing professor. Online homework is due midnight M, W, F which helps break up the workload and better understand the corresponding lectures. She is very funny and does a lot of in-class "demos" which makes the class interesting. The homework and other assignments are not hard at all and help bring up the grade. Practice tests are very helpful.

she never finished any lecture so we had to watch them and fill in the notes ourselves... she gave us a ton of homework, (hw due 2 days before and the day before our final) test are nothing like practice test, and she goes super fast so you wont get all of the info. SIs are a waste of time, go to a plus. Overall, she was very difficult.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Easily the easiest chem 119 prof at a&m, however chem is still really tough. To me her lectures are heavy but she is so passionate and knows what she is talking about, so it makes learning easier. She gives you SO much help with practice exams, clickers, and more on her website to help study for exams! Also SI sessions are SO helpful! Take her!!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Williamson is the best intro to Chem teacher. She gives practice exams that are very indicative of the actual exam. The homework is a little tedious but not too much at all. Overall, I probably put 2-3 hours into this class a week. She does do clicker, but you need to get like 70% right to get a 100. Easy A as long as you dont slack off.

Her notes are too disorganized and not much helpful for her more difficult exams. Tests are worded very tricky and weirdly, and too few questions gives room for more error and point deductions. Attendance is counted by clicker questions.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Williamson is passionate about what she teaches and is capable of effectively communicating the information. Her tests are not hard if you actively engage yourself in learning the information.

She's too disorganized for me to learn or understand anything

reviews.comment: Williamson is the easiest chem 119/101 teacher. If you go to tutoring and do the homework you will get an A

Dr. Williamson is the best professor to start off with. I hated chemistry before, but now that I understand it, I find chemistry so fun. I owe it all to Dr. Williamson. She's also so nice during lecture and office hours. She honestly cares and tries her best to help. Her tests are easy if you study the material.

Dr. Williamson is a great prof. She really seems to care about you and always makes time to answer your questions. There is the usual online textbook with homework. The exams are a lot of theory so definitely understand the concepts. The ppts are online so print those out before class as well. Go to class because there are clicker questions.

Awesome professor .My best so far. She legitimately cares about her students. I watched her become equally concerned about the outcome of a student's scholarship issues as the student herself (if not more visibly so,) but without a hint of being disingenuous. Mad respect. Her exams are hard, but fair, and she amply "warns" you with the homework.
Very nice lady. She does a good job lecturing, but does tend to get off topic easily. She made class easy and less stressful with her positivity.

Chem is tough no matter what in my opinion, but I believe she is the best chem prof at a&m. She explains everything step by step w/ many examples in class. Homework also helps better understand. Exams are tough mainly due to lack of time, so make sure to be as time efficient as possible. Go to class - clicker questions every class for points.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Would definitely take again! The sweetest woman who cares about how her students are doing, and wants everyone to succeed. Shes very approachable and if you ever have any issues, she will work with you!!

How to do prepare for this class - 2 things you should do: 1. Download notes PDF (from her website) over what will be talked about in class and fill it up while she lectures. 2. Do sample exams. Just review notes and doing sample exams- understand each question. You should be good. Took her 102 did same thing got even higher, she really is good.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Good prof, but lectures had too many demos instead of practice problems. No curve on tests, but curves at very end. Tests are ok loves conceptual ?s. Practice tests are accurate. I took AP Chem so pretty easy for me. Homework not too bad. She puts a lot of effort into it, but gets a bit too excited at times to where required material is not covered

Took her for CHEM 102, and she was a good choice. Very sweet and always happy to help during office hours. Every time I would go in, and ask questions on past exams, she was able to take her time with each student to make sure they understood the concepts. Attend lectures because there are attendance questions that will help your overall grade.

People say she's the "easiest" chem 101/102 professor at TAMU- she's slower at teaching. If you take her 101, you need her for 102 or you will be really behind the other professors in content. Okay lectures, moderate homework loads, generally easy assignments. Overall decent prof. Not too hard to pass, but didn't cover all material in the semester.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Vickie is a tricky professor and doesn't always explain the concepts well, but I went to A+ tutoring for this class and it helped a lot. It's hard to get an A in here unless you consistently get As on her tests, but her exams are very predictable and not nearly as difficult and advanced as other professors. Highly recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Williamson is a good prof. I had McCartney first semester for 101 and their teaching styles and tests are very different. Williamson's tests are more conceptual base. She drops your lowest test grade if your final test is higher than one of them so that is a plus. Attending SI's and IA exam review's helped a ton.

Dr Williamson provides exam objectives, practice exams, and partial credit for certain exam questions. If you pay attention to sample exams & clicker questions you should know exactly what she will ask on exams. She has homework 3 times a week, which helps solidify concepts but can become overwhelming at times. She really cares about her students.

I love this lady, she is hilarious, helpful, and knows what she is talking about. Her class is slightly difficult, but as long as you do the homework, participate in Clickers (go to class!!), and do her practice exams, you should pass the class, no problem. This is my second semester with her and I'm thriving. Highly recommended professor.

She drops the loweset exam grade; 4 exams, 8 assignments
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Williamson was by far my favorite prof my freshman year. Chem is a hard class but her tests are very predictable and with all the homework and other assignment grades, there is a bit of a cushion. LOTS of online homework, be prepared for nightly homework. reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Williamson is a great professor who really loves what she teaches. She gives students all the resources they need to succeed. I'm taking her again for 102.
She is a nice lady . Test are though not many questions . Studied TONS and went to A+ still got a B !

This class was really challenging for me. I HIGHLY recommend going to A PLUS tutoring, it helped me so much. Williamson was not very good at explaining. I learned a lot of things on my own time. Must attend class bc there are clicker questions every time. Her tests are very conceptual so you must know material.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She was a good prof, and she gave her all in teaching. The lectures are the most important part of the class. She requires clicker questions (questions in class that you have to answer with a remote that count toward the final grade). If you take GOOD NOTES and read the text, an A in the class is definite. Also, her practice exams are accurate.

Lectures are straight and to the point, and she does do clicker questions so make sure you come to class or it'll affect your grade. Her tests have concept based as well as mathematical questions, but as long as you do her online review tests and understand the homework, you'll get an A.

Williamson's lectures are very average, and her tests aren't simply math, it's also very conceptual. She gives you MANY resources to prepare for tests, if you dedicate yourself and use all her resources you should be okay. Attend class so you can get clicker points & do all the homework, it''ll help you learn. (I did not take AP Chem in HS)

I don't have experience with any other chem professors, but Williamson was great. She really does care for her students a lot. There is homework due after every lecture, but don't let that scare you. It's pretty much just a completion grade because it lets you do it until you get it right. I would also recommend going to A plus for tutoring.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Williamson is an AMAZING professor. She gives a lot of homework, but it is helpful and good practice for her tests. Going to class isn't mandatory, but if you want extra credit, you definitely go for clicker points.

Dr. Williamson is an amazing prof and made the course very easy. I am taking her next semester as well. The only downside is that she goes out of the typical order which makes Lab a little more difficult, but I was still able to get an A in both. I would highly suggest her over the other options.

Dr. Williamson is the best! She provides fill-in-the-blank powerpoint slides and she's all about making sure her students understand. She is NOT memorization-heavy and is very caring. She provides tons of resources, including practice exams and videos working some of the practice exam problems. Very clear grading criteria, lots of help

Lots of homework on MindTap but it really helps to teach you. Her own private website is a gem and helped me pass this class. She posts practice exams there and tapes her lectures there as well. Going to Ryan's test reviews helps a TON, sometimes he can explain a topic better than her. She also drops a few bad grades to help boost your final grade.

I've never seen a professor put in so much effort for the class. Williamson will probably explain Chemistry better than any other professor available, and she offers a whole lot of small assignments to boost your grade. She has her TA do a review before the test, which I found to be super helpful

She has a personal website with all of her power points and taped lectures., which comes in super handy to study. Her tests are similar to her practice exams, and she gives partial credit, but the tests are really short. If you do the MindTap homework and the practice exams, you'll do really well. Go to Ryan's test reviews! They help a lot.
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She really does care about the individual student but the course work is very hard to understand the concepts.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is such an awesome person. I enjoy this class so much. Although it is hard material, she always tries to make it interesting with demonstrations in class. She is hilarious and keeps me entertained in class. Her tests are very conceptual based, but with all the resources she provides you can make a good grade if you study.

There's clicker questions, so you can't miss class. There's this major assignment due the first week it was 36 points and took several hours. After that its just homework on mind tap every other day. It does not really help you for the exam. Office hours are the best. Do what's on her frequently asked questions and Practice Exams. She's caring.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Easily the sweetest professor at A&M. Cares for every single one of her students and their success. If you do poorly on exams, you have room to pick your grade up with her online assignments. Explains everything in an understanding way and doesn't make things unnecessarily hard. She's the best even if you don't care for chemistry!
If i had a dollar for every time she said "so the idea is" id be a millionaire

I did not really like her as a professor, she doesn't work out a lot of problems thoroughly, considering that this class incorporates a lot of math. Try to learn the material in different ways. Keep up with the homework, or it WILL pile up. Math and chemistry work hand in hand, you need to know both to understand her lectures and pass her exams.

Shes a great teacher! She had printable notes, that if you study hard, you'll do great! Easy homework system (just a lot). She has extra credit clicker questions and she reviews the tests before and after. TIP: the notes are what is key, really understand them and the example problems on them.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: One of my favorite profs so far. Homework is online through the textbook but most of the time if you're paying attention in class you won't even need to read it. Great at explaining chem concepts and really wants you to do well. Tests are multiple choice and she gives partial credit for some answers. She also gives out awesome study guides before
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Doctor Williamson is an amazing professor, who tries to make class interesting. However, she is a much better professor at chem 101 then chem 102. It seemed like she struggled to explain concepts and was more difficult to understand. Her tests are conceptual and pretty difficult. APlus was my best friend. Her final is easy, but she does not curve.

You can show up to class and not pay attention and get an A. I took with BIOL112 and Calc 2. Her reviews are EXACTLY like the tests and her final is easier thany any of the exams. Just do the homework and you'll be fine. CHEM 102 is difficult but you have to put in the work like any class. She does cool demo experiments in class! Go to class!
test were just as hard as other profs but homework system was easier, be sure to do the sample exams

reviews.comment: Ridiculously easy, go to A plus tutoring and get a season pass. I got a 100 on 3/4 tests and the final, since her tests are pretty short and straightforward. I feel like she's the easier professor, but you still have to work hard. If you underestimate her, you won't do well. Didn't learn much in her lectures- most learning happened at A plus.

Definitely fell into the rumors of Williamson being the easiest professor. Though she is definitely the nicest and most wholesome professor out of the rest, I wouldn't say she is the easiest. Her exams are really difficult due to them being so short and they play a huge factor in your grade. She writes her own exams so A+ doesn't help.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I don't recommend her for Chem 102...

After taking Williamson for both 101 and 102, I def recommend her for both. 101 was kind of a joke, but 102 is much harder in comparison. She does a lot to make sure you master the material, but you also need to put in the effort.  Go to OH and SI if you dont understand something, b/c material builds up. Shes the best, get her if you can!
reviews.ratingTags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Nope she is not the easy prof. Doesn't curve AT ALL. Spent so much time on hw and learned more from that than lectures. A nice lady but she did not make chemistry easy to understand. I took her because I'd heard amazing things (had bethel for chem 101, made a B) but her tests were ridiculous. A+ didn't help because she knows all the tricks.

reviews.comment: I would not say Williamson is the easiest chem prof, it really just depends. Williamson is more theory based rather than math based, so give or take. Her tests are extremely short usually being 14-16 questions but her questions are easier than other profs. However, she doesn't curve so if you miss 1 question you are down to a low A so beware.
Don't take her for Chem 102.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I had Dr. Williamson for chem 101 and 102. 102 is harder but I studied more for it and that's why I am getting an A. Office hours help a TON and her exams are a lot like the practice ones she posts. Rewrite the notes before exams, do the homework ASAP, and don't let yourself leave class confused! Tests can be hard to finish in time but it's doable.

The reason why this class was difficult was bc the tests are so short. She also teaches in a very specific way so if that doesn't work for you then oh well. She has little tricks that she puts in your test so no matter how long you've studied you could miss 2 ?s and get a B on an exam. The only good thing is she drops the lowest exam grade
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She often doesn't teach to the test and so when she has a couple of unfamiliar questions on the test when there's only 14-16 to begin with, this can become challenging. Outside tutoring is most likely required.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: SHE ROCKS! I in no way think chemistry is interesting or easy, but Dr. Williamson is a great professor who loves what she does and makes it somewhat interesting. Her tests are fair (half is math, the other half is theory). I took McCartney for 101 but managed to get Dr. WIlliamson for 102 thank goodness. She is the best gen chem prof for sure.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Took her for Chem 101/102. In my opinion, her lectures were pretty bad. I learned way more from the homework than I ever did from her lectures. I took her based off of these reviews, and felt mislead thinking her class would be easy. I managed a B, but I dont feel like that was due to her teaching abilities.

Vickie is a solid prof! She made chem understandable and had lots of demo experiments in class. Tests could be a bit tricky sometimes, but follow her objective sheets and you'll be fine. You'll learn chemistry, especially for pre-meds. She also likes to relate chem to medicine. Used MindTap in lieu of a textbook and did fine. Definitely take her!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: She was an awesome professor wish I could've gotten her again for 102. Make sure to do her sample exams.

Awesome professor who is fair in her level of difficulty. She is caring for her students and makes an honest effort to keep the class interesting and fun. Definitely the best chem prof you can get at TAMU.
As long as you do the practice test you will do fine. The only problem is she does not curve and I ended with a 89.9 in the class and it showed up as a B.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY--Would take again

reviews.comment: It is definitely feasible to make an A in this course, but you have to work for it. I personally enjoyed her lectures, but I wish she went more in depth on some topics. Tests are pretty difficult, but if you start studying a week or so in advance you should be able to make a B on most.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: She uses iClickers to test knowledge, meaning you won't get the points unless you show up to class. There was plenty of access to her office hours and SI sessions, so there is help available if you need it. I didn't utilize it to the fullest extent, but still passed the class. She isn't a stellar lecturer, but she is one of the nicer profs.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: You don't use the textbook, but you still have to buy it to do the online homework. Do all the online homework and the reviews and you should be okay for her exams. There is no extra credit.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Williamson is a great prof. Make sure you read the textbook portions above the homework it helps a lot. DO NOT BUY THE TEXTBOOK YOU WON'T USE IT. The tests are not to difficult but make sure you study. Go to class to get clicker points. Her class is very entertaining, and she does an experiment everyday. She is always available for help In OH.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Williamson is the cutest prof!!! Makes grading criteria very clear. Her clicker questions from class are major hints for the tests
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Professor Williamson is AMAZING. She really cares about her students education. She goes above and beyond to make sure we all understand the material. If you do the homework and attend lecture, exams should seem like a piece of cake.

This class is so easy and Dr. Williamson is such a nice professor that I feel like she and all of her students are on a first name basis. Textbook reading is very minimal and the homework is so spread out that it takes very little time. The tests are also very easy as her motto is that "tests should be easier than the homework".

I had a fairly weak background coming into chem 101, and she has made this course much easier than I expected it to be. There is a decent amount of homework, but it definitely helps you learn. I am taking her next semester for chem 102.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Williams has been my favorite professor at TAMU thus far! She genuinely cares about her students/ wants you to do well and gives you all of the tools needed to be successful. The online homework can be annoying/lengthy, but the only way to learn chemistry/math is through practice! Out of all of the chem 101 professors to take... she is the best

Williamson is an great prof and I am taking her again for CHEM102. She does have a lot of homework (usually due three times a week) but it helps a lot with concepts. Class is mandatory because she uses clickers. With that being said, you only need 70% of clicker points so you can miss a few lectures and still be okay!
Professor Williamson is by far the best chemistry professor A&M has. If you pay attention in class & do the online homework, you can definitely get an A in her class
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She's a good professor. A plus tutoring really helps out. Gives reviews. Class is hard(Its chem all chem classes are hard), but she is the best chem prod at A&M bc she explains things well and I have friends who have other chem prof and are not doing well so I would def try to get her if I were you!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Would take again

reviews.comment: Lectures are easy to follow and she is quick to reply if you email her. There was a lot of homework this semester but it was not terribly difficult. If you don't understand chemistry that well, buy a pass at A Plus and it helps a bunch! Would take again, covers material at a good pace, not too fast.

Dr. Williamson was a great prof, I took her for chem 101. You have to go to class to get the clicker point questions and she does give large amounts of homework but the homework help you prepare for the exam. Her exams are really tough but if you study you should be fine, go to 4.0, they really help with her class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Williamson is by far the best chemistry prof at A&M. She is not only one of the nicest and most caring professors, but is also amazing at teaching her students. Her lectures are always clear, organized, and full of fun demonstrations. While there is a lot of homework, it really is for your own benefit and really helps understand the material.

Williamson is a great professor. I had her for chem 101 and 102. She is really sweet and caring. She does have a lot of conceptual questions on her exam, which can be difficult. Go to class for the clicker questions. Homework is very easy!! There's no extra credit though.

Dr. Williamson is the best chemistry prof at TAMU hands down. She thoroughly explains every concept and gives out two practice exams before each test. The homework is actually helpful. She drops the lowest test grade if the percentage from your final is higher.

Very passionate and motivating. Had to really work and study though. MindTap helped study for the test more than anything else. Lab was tough, but the lab practical was easy. Lecture tests were definitely tricky and tedious. Tough class, but you will learn a lot. Just rework the problems from past exams and MindTap.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I had Williamson for Chem 101 and did poorly which is very out of character. Prof Williamson is very sweet but her tests do not reflect her practice exams or in class lecture material (plus they are often very difficult). Everyone I know that did well in this class also went to A+ religiously, but I didn't have the $.I wish I had taken someone else

Dr. Williamson was one of the most recommended professors by my advisor. She uses clicker questions each day so attendance is mandatory. Lots of homework, but your overall grade depends on a lot of different categories so doing not so good in one area of class isn't terrible. She does a lot of demos to show concepts and ideas.

Really loved Dr. Williamson! She is really understanding, and that helps a lot. Go to A Plus! Her class made Chem 102 bearable after having a harder professor for Chem 101. Wish I could take her again!

I absolutely loved Dr. Williamson. Yes, you do have to attend lectures in order to get clicker question credit, but she is a very solid professor and knows her stuff. Theoretical on tests can get really tough, but the homework will help you with understanding the material. If you can, go to A plus! They really helped me with her class.

I could have easily made an A in this class if I studied for the tests harder. The homework system is very helpful and the clicker questions that she does every lecture are very similar to the difficulty of test questions. She posts practice exams before every test that are exactly like the test that is about to be taken.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I was lucky enough to get Dr. Williamson again for CHEM 112. From my personal experience, I did not learn anything from her lectures, but I know many people who did. The great thing about her is that if you go to A Plus, the strategies they teach and their practice problems apply perfectly to her tests. Chem 112 is hard but Dr. W makes it bearable!

Vickie's class is not terrible if you are good at chemistry or are a chemistry major. I am sure she is the best professor at TAMU. The subject is difficult and generally you will get one letter grade lower than you did in Chem 101. No curve given even if your end grade is close to the next letter grade.

Took her for 101 & 102. Have to go to class for clicker points. If you ever have a question, ask her the day of or you will get behind!! She goes slower than most other professors so not as much material is covered on the tests. The math questions are easy on her test, but the theoretical will get you down to a B! If you're good at math take Bethel
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Williamson is one of, if not the best, gen chem profs A&M has to offer. While she doesn't go as fast as the others, she goes very in depth into the more important chem subjects so you actually remember this material later on. She does not curve but you final exam grade can replace your lowest of four exams.

If you can get in, definitely take Williamson! She is not only a great teacher, but a very respected and nice professor who is always on top of things and truly cares for her students. I had her for chem 101 and 102, and learned a lot and remained very interested in chemistry also!! Her tests are exactly what she teaches you and very fair!

Dr. Williamson is wonderful. She keeps the subject interesting and wants every student she has to perform well. Her office hours are excellent, she has a great system and she's always willing to answer questions. Had her for chem 101 and 102, if I could take her again I totally would!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Williamson is the best option for chem 101 and 102. There is a good amount of homework due every sunday night but it helps you learn the material. The homework is online and you have 10 attempts per question. She gives sample exams before tests that are pretty similar but a little easier than her real tests. her tests are easier than other profs

she is like your grandma/mom is teaching you chem. she wants you to succeed. explains things thoroughly and knows what she is talking about. it becomes really easy to quote her. "3-2-1-and done" "turn to your partner and..."

Best professor for 101 and 102. Lectures are helpful but not necessary. Her homework and practice tests are the most important, fairly easy tests and she awards partial credit. Get Williamson for chem if at all possible!

Had her for Inorganic Chem I, and am taking her again for II. She does exciting and fun demos! She gives a good amount of homework, but doing it well will make you learn. A genuinely nice professor. She's really generous with the "fluff" points so you'll get an A with B-average midterms, a B with C-average midterms, etc. Use her practice tests!!!

I enjoyed Dr. Williamson very much! She is focused on how students learn her material which benefits those who have her classes. The material is taught well and tests may/may not be hard depending on how you study. She occasionally misspeaks on things which may be confusing.

Dr. Williamson was an amazing teacher. She does experiments during lecture to help you understand what she is teaching. Does clicker questions and gives homework but both of these things help you learn and comprehend what she is teaching. Very good during office hours.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Williamson is actually a really good professor, If you do the homework on mindtap and actually understand how to get the solutions, you'll be fine. The only thing I dreaded on her test were the content questions(true/false) ughhh.

Williamson is an amazing professor. She has demos in almost every lecture and breaks the material down so you can understand it. Beware, there will be trick questions on the tests! Her tests are difficult but if you study hard and go to office hours you will be fine. Her office hours are a HUGE resource for her class!!!

Dr. Williamson genuinely cares about her students learning the material. She loves chemistry, and that shows in her lectures. She assigns a lot of homework each week, but it's manageable if you can do some after each lecture. If you have to take chemistry, I recommend taking her!! You still have to work for an A, but she makes it doable.

Dr. W is the best of the Chem teachers but STILL IS NOT EASY. Her test avg. is always in the 70s. If you want an A in this class GO TO A PLUS TUTORING! Her lectures alone are not enough! Homework is easy but time consuming! She does clicker questions so go to class! My midterm grade was a C but I ended with an A ONLY thanks to A plus! Not an easy A
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Dr. Williamson is one of the best professors I've ever had! She is hilarious and does demos every class. She also has clicker questions every class period so attendance is a must. Her tests aren't that bad and are pretty close to the practice test. Go to A+ for an easy A, but it's not mandatory. She is definitely the best CHEM101 professor at A&M.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Her class is difficult but worth it. Her tests are easier than other CHEM101 profs (or so I've heard). Uses MindTap homework which has been statistically proven to be "better" than the other homework systems. She literally wins awards for teaching chemistry because she's so amazing. Go to class to get clicker points that help boost your grade.

Williamson is the best Chem teacher at A&M. Her tests are the easiest out of all the professors but you still have to study a lot for them. She makes you work for it, but it is do able. Only have to attend 70% of classes for your grade. A lot of homework but easy and didn't take too long (due end of every week). She gives 2 sample exams per test.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Williamson was a great professor!! She went over all material very clearly, and has her class laid out very organized, so you can always plan ahead.  Homework due pretty much every Sunday online, so you know how much you will have to do.  Pretty easy to get 100s on all assignments except for tests, which are not too difficult.  Take her!!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Williamson was definitely my favorite prof this semester. She is so sweet and her lectures are very easy to follow if you pay attention and keep up with the homework. She does a lot of demos and keeps you entertained during the lectures. She does do clicker questions so attendance is mandatory for the most part.

Dr. Williamson is a really sweet lady who really cares about her students! Although I probably could have learned more from another professor, she took the time to make sure we were understanding what she taught. She does spend a bit too much time on demos rather than lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is literally the best professor. Sometimes what she talks about ca be confusing, but doing the homework helps to fully understand everything. She also LOVES demos to explain certain topics which actually really helps.

Williamson is a very good professor. She makes it easy to follow along in her lectures, she is always willing to answer questions, and it's very clear that she knows what she is teaching. Her tests aren't super hard, but you definitely need to spend a lot of time studying for them.

If you're lucky to find a spot available, take Williamson. Demos everyday, clicker questions everyday, and start to finish lecturing everyday. Only about 13-20 questions on an exam but you will be crunched on time.

SHE IS GREAT! She does slides in class that you print out. Clickers every day so I guess attendance is mandatory but you can miss some and be fine. She uses MindTap on OWLs, which is less homework but not as much homework. Don't buy textbook, you'll get one when you get MindTap. Not "easy A" but not tough. GREAT 10/10 recommend.

I love Dr. Williamson! She obviously has a passion for her students and her subject, and works hard to connect and make subjects interesting. Plus, she enjoys blowing things up and setting things on fire, which is fun.

My best prof of the semester, she is very smart and is caring, which is hard to find. She gives a lot of homework but it is all helpful and relevant to the test, so you can count it as graded study which is super easy. I would recommend going to A+, but I am terrible at Chem and know many people who did not have too. Defiantly  recommend her.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Super easy A if you have chem background, doable A even if you don't. Just pay attention in lecture and while doing MindTap HW! Practice tests are a must. She's so sweet and her demos are fun.

Had her for 101&102 - 102 was definitely a lot more work. Spend time on MindTap, it'll teach you everything. Don't save them for Sunday. ALWAYS do her practice tests! Not sure if I learned a lot, but her class was pretty easy with (minimum) 2-3 hours spent on HW/week. WRITE DOWN 'most missed' problems and keep em safe! They'll be on the final.

Williamson is an awesome prof and probably the easiest chem prof to take. Her tests are fairly simple and if you study it will pay off. The one negative of her class: she will not curve your final grade no matter how close you are. GO TO A+
If you need to take Chem, take Dr. Williamson for 101 and for 102 if you can get her. I took her class for both semesters and got a B in both. An A is definitely possible if you go to A plus!

If you have to take 101 or 102, TAKE WILLIAMSON!!! Has so many practice tests and worksheets to help you on the test, and posts most lectures online and works out sample exams to review for the tests which helps so much. Received a C because chemistry isn't really my subject, but she offers so much help for your grade!

Dr. Williamson is a great professor because she not only teaches you the material but explains how it applies to topics in your major. I suggest going to her office hours when exams are out because she is really helpful in answering questions. She also has sample exams and reviews, slides, and lecture videos if needed.

If you take advantage of her many office hours, you can learn one on one. Her lectures suck, but she knows a lot and to me that only showed during her office hours. I would suggest only taking this class if you can dedicate most of your time to being in her office hours to learn without having to focus on another class.

I had Collins for CHEM 101 and thought he was SO hard. However, I quickly found myself actually wanting to take Collins again for 102 this semester instead of Williamson. Williamson always goes over the lecture time, does more demos than teaching, and has not been super helpful to me in office hours. For me, the good word on her isn't true.

Williamson cares about her students and likes what she does. She does a lot of demos, but she does not work out a lot of math in class. The homework teaches you basically everything. Her exam review videos are slightly helpful, but her exams have tricks or curveballs on them. There is never enough time to finish them even though they arent long

Lectures are muddled, always goes beyond class time, and a lot of her exam questions are topics that aren't covered. I really haven't learned much from her, in general tough gen chem profs are pretty bad and they're stuck teaching this instead of Ochem for a reason.

Dr. Williamson is an amazing professor.  Those who think that she doesn't teach well probably didn't put much effort into the class, thinking she was the "easy" prof. Her class is not easy, unless easy means you know what to expect on exams.  She is also extremely sweet, and wants you to succeed. Had her for 101 and 102, absolutely no regrets. :)

Dr. Williamson's teaching style revolves more around demos and pop quizzes than detailed lectures. Her exams are basically the same as her sample exams. If you're looking for an easy A without learning much about chemistry, go ahead and sign up for her class. If you're looking to actually learn and understand chemistry, take another professor.

Dr Williamson is a great professor. I had Dr Bethel for Chem101 and worked hard to make an A in his class. But Dr Williamson's class is much easier and a lot less work. Yes, you must study for the tests but the information is very straight forward and doing the homework and her past exams helps a lot.

I suck at Chemistry. However, Williamson is a good instructor and provides the resources you need to pass. The only problem I had with her class was the tests. She would give you a really old "formula sheet" and sometimes you didn't even need half the info on it. Overall, study and go to class. You will regret it if you don't!

I personally don't think the good word is true. She teaches the class like we are in middle school. Maybe if used half the time she spends doing "demos" and clicker questions to actually teach chemistry we wouldn't be a chapter behind Bethel's class less than halfway through the semester.

Dr. Williamson's class convinced me to switch my major from bio to chem. She's super helpful and really wants her students to succeed. Her practice tests are pretty close to her actual exams. Go to class because she has clicker questions. She also has extra assignments that help boost your grade. I recommend her 100%. You will not be disappointed.

I though she was overrated. Her tests difficult. A lot different than the practice tests she posted. She lectured well and included tons of examples Pulled out a B with the help of Aplus and lots of studying. It's a hard course but she's apparently the best out there compared to the rest.

Dr. Williamson is a gem of a professor. She perfectly balances keeping material challenging with keeping the tests passable. She is also an incredibly sweet person - always being there for students, and never making you feel stupid for not understanding the material. My advice: do her homework and take her advice.  She is amazing; you'll love her!
She is a wonderful professor who really tries to help her students. Go to class, although it is not mandatory, there are "clicker questions" for points and she is entertaining.

In the beginning of the semester I used to call her Ickie Vickie, only because I failed my first test. After that i realized how college isn't like high school and you need to work for it, so I did and went to A+ and did all my homework. After all the hard work I ended up making an A in her class. She is the best Chem teacher and truly cares.

Really clear, fun, & easy (especially if you took AP Chem in HS). Tests are a bit harder than what we get in class and on sample tests, but sample tests are really good to study with. Her office hours are nice. She always does demos for real life application. She's been doing this for a long time. I only had to spend about 1hr/wk for this class.

Williamson ROCKS! Take her. Take her. Take her. There's no one else that teaches CHEM 101 as well as her! I didn't go to any tutoring agency off campus, and made A's on all tests! You'll have MindTap homework due every Sunday, but it's not bad! Her office hours are so helpful! ALWAYS do the sample exams before tests!!

I loved Professor Williamson so much, I'm taking her for 102! She's very clear about what material will be on the exams, she doesn't assign too much homework (it's all online), and she's super sweet. Can't say enough good things about her. Take the class alongside A+ Tutoring!!! Do the exam reviews and the homework, and you should be fine.

She is an incredibly nice woman and her class was very manageable. Homework and assignments were very doable and her class is made to help those who struggle with chemistry. I took this class alongside A+ Tutoring and it definitely HELPED A LOT. Overall, Williamson was very helpful and I enjoyed her class a lot would definitely take again.

I loved having her as my professor. Her homework is very easy and manageable. She is always organized and prepared for class. Her mock tests are so helpful and usually are very very similar to the actual tests. She's also really funny and very friendly. I would definitely take one of her classes again.

she is a great professor. chemistry is a hard subject but she helps in any way possible and to break it down. she always has an experiment to do in class to help you remember what we learned in class. i love her.
Lots of homework but does what she can to make the class easy. Clicker points everyday so attendance is super important.

Professor Williamson is awesome!! I had a really bad high school experience with chemistry, meaning I took Chem 101 with no chemistry background at all.  I went to her office hours all the time and she was always super helpful. She does demos at the beginning of class and makes the class fun and interesting.  I would definitely take her class again

Dr. Williamson is such a cute woman! She gives great lectures and uses clicker points every class. She gives a lot of homework and other outside assignments, but as long as you stay on top of them, they aren't too bad. Her tests are a bit tricky on wording so be careful, but she still is the best chem professor here.

Dr. Williamson is a fair professor. She keeps her lectures engaging by having little experiments in class. Homework is weekly usually due Sunday's. Homework helps a lot when it comes to learning the material. Her exams aren't hard at all. She is hands down the best chemistry professor A&M has.
easiest chem prof. recommend going to A+ along with her lectures

She is awesome prof, the best chem prof in all of A&M, will fight for a sport in her chem102 class! Her tests are hard but the subject is hard and be very aware of the wording on the tests the number one reason to fail her test is not reading what the question is asking, otherwise class really isn't hard. Does demos every class and is the best!!!

She is very enthusiastic about what she teachers. The lectures often have boring material but she spices things up with whacky experiments that relate to the slide show. Tests are very similar to the review. Homework is easy and there is lots of extra credit. I highly recommend taking her. It's an easy A and she's genuinely nice and helpful.
I loved Williamson so much. If I could take her for the rest of my sciences I would. She is there to help the best she can and test are super fair. Go to  A+ and study and you will be fine.

Dr. Williamson cares a lot about her students and is definitely there for you.  I had Mccartney for 101 and switched to Williamson for 102, best decision I've ever made.  Tests are fair but not many questions so you can't miss too many.  Makes you work for it however an A is achievable if you put in the effort!

Dr. Williamson was by far my favorite professor at A&M so far, she makes tests fair(not easy but reasonable) and she will also help you as much as she can in office hours. She actually cares for her students which is nice compared to other profs, I highly recommend her because she gives you the resources to succeed. Take her, you won't regret it.

CHEM 102 is a difficult course, but Dr. Williamson is so kind and patient and is so helpful in her office hours. Her tests were not too bad if you studied, although I was always caught off guard by a couple of questions. The fact that she replaces with lowest exam grade with the average of your others saved my grade. I highly recommend her.

Williamson is probably the best CHEM 101 prof! She has special assignments (extra credit) that give you a grade bump. Her exams are fair and similar to the practice ones online. She's super approachable and knows what she is doing. She will answer questions in a timely manner and wants you to succeed.

She goes really fast and doesn't care if you understand it, just tells you to come in for office hours. She gives quizzes a lot and does not allow much time to finish them. I switched to McCartney my second semester and liked her a lot more.
She is a great teacher. I would highly recommend you take her. She makes Chem really make sense and she cares for her students.

She's extremely helpful and she does demos almost every lecture. I appreciate the clicker questions because they are  extra practice. I really struggle with Chem but she truly wants to help you. She has increased my interest in chemistry and I enjoy the class. It's a hard course but go to her office hours and read the chapters in the book

Heard great things about her coming in so I took her class. Not sure what all the hype was for. She is very nice and knows chemistry, but as far as learning in her class, it was difficult for me. The pro is that she drops your lowest exam grade.  A+ tutoring is the place to go if you want to learn the material. Guaranteed to raise your grade.
Solid Professor.
Gives you everything you need to know during lectures. Not too many assignments. Tests are straightforward and simple.

She gives lots of homework and assignments, but this is to help your grade as her test are pretty tough. The clicker questions are hard, but they don't count for a ton. They will help your grade in the end though. She moves VERY fast, but her online test reviews are very helpful. Shes very good about responding to questions you email her.
She really loves lecturing and chemistry, but she's sometimes confusing and goes too fast. Her tests are always tough too, but a good professor at that

Professor Williamson was one of the best college professors I've had in a while. Her lectures are easy to understand and she really wants her students to succeed. She is always willing to help and understands that chemistry is a hard course for some people. She gives quite a bit of work to bring up your grade. Take her if you can!

I've had bad experiences with professors, but I was pleasantly surprised by Prof. Williamson. She's helpful and knowledgable. With that said, it's still a hard course. I ended up with a good grade, but it was due to a lot of dedication and online resources like clutch prep. I would recommend taking her class, but don't expect it to be a cake walk.

This class is difficult, but as a professor she teaches the information with ease. Although I didn't get the grade I wanted in the class, I still believe she is a good prof. She gives practice exams that are similar to the tests and is always available for questions. I would highly recommend her.

Dr. Williams is a fantastic professor. She gives out plenty of opportunities for good grades, such as clicker questions, easy quizzes, and OWLS. She's funny and does experiments in class! Overall an enjoyable class.

My favorite class of Spring 2013! Coming from a HORRIBLE experience from CHEM 101, she is a life changer she'll make you like Chemistry. She has practice tests which are pretty accurate of the actual ones. She does demos (little experiments) in class.  Highly recommend her.

I was not looking forward to chem at all. She has print out powerpoint notes, USE THESE! They make her lectures much clearer. Always do the practice exams, it'll give you a good idea of what will be on the test. Go to class for clicker points! If you are able to get this professor, DON'T WAIT. She's the one every one wants!
I was scared about taking chemistry at first, but she made it very enjoyable, ended up being my favorite class

I've had 2 chem classes in high school and HATED chem, but she made chemistry soooo easy to understand! She is definitely the best chem professor at my school and if u give minimum effort, there is no way u can receive a grade lower than a high b

She is an amazing professor! I highly recommend her. She has clicker questions in class, so class is mandatory but you only have to get 70% to get full credit. She has practice tests that are very similar to the exam, I didn't even open my textbook. She has fill in the blank notes available online that are super helpful as well.

i requested her when signing up for classes, but wish i hadnt. she moves too fast to keep up with. her tests are slightly tricky, and the practice tests dont have as hard questions as the real test. we have difficult "clicker questions" over material that we just went over, w/ 30 sec to answer. God help you if you're a little confused on the info!
She is a great prof and is clear. I don't see how it would be possible to get below a B in her class if you actually study.

She is a great teacher! Very helpful and excited about chemistry. She gives practice tests and fill in notes. Compared to the other teachers the amount of homework is greatly reduced. As long as you go to class and take notes you should be alright. I would definitely take her again!

I did everything I possibly could to get into her class because everyone told me I should, but I regret it. She's good, and very nice, well prepared, and organized. But her lectures are overwhelming. She talks non stop, its impossible to think fast enough for the quizzes. So much homework. A lot to keep up with, but she was fine, but not great.
Talks to you like you're in elementary school but its good because it makes everything easy to understand. Tests are so easy, I never study for them ever and make a 100.

Friendly and enthusiastic. Seems to genuinely care about teaching and finds ways to make lectures fun (i.e. blowing up stuff in class). I would love to take another course from her. The material she covers on tests is hard but not impossible. She also is very good about grading quickly and returning graded papers to you. Loved her class.

She is very enthusiastic in class and enjoys what she teaches. She has an SI which is helpful. Her tests are easy especially if you go to the SI sessions along with A+. Homework is a large portion of her overall grade which is nice.
Best teacher I've had so very. She's very fair on grades. There is a lot of homework but it helps. I would def. reccomand this teacher.

She is easy as long as you memorize her notes verbatim and know how to complete all the problems. The final is tough, so I made a B. But I did not have to go to A+. Make sure you don't give up at the end because you think she's easy. The material gets harder. Listen and understand her lectures. Go though the problems she does in class again.

I don't understand the love for this professor. Her class is more challenging than it needs to be. She makes you take clicker quizzes during class while blasting the jeopardy music. When I studied the reviews and homework, I though that I'd be fine. However, when the test came, the alterations and trickiness of the questions made the exam   hard.

Really enjoys teaching, assigns alot of online hw but it helps your grade. drops your lowest test grade which helps a lot provides old exams on her website so you can practice and know what to expect. Go to A+ tutoring and you will make an easy A without doing any outside studying, if not then her class will be more difficult for you.
Very interesting! Does experiments and examples in most classes.

Definitely one of the worst professors I've had at A&M. The first week of lab had material that you learned friday on the 6th week of school. It is a time killer with quizzes in-class and out-of-class. OWLS (online-homework) is redundant and the exams try to trick you in multiple ways. Study ahead and you'll be fine. Don't miss a class.
I liked the fill in the blank notes, they made me go to class and pay attention and I didn't have to right everything! The tests were still tricky though

I did not like this prof's teaching style.. she has fill in the blank notes and does not post the complete notes online. TONS of homework and TRICKY tests. I do not recommend this prof if you are not willing to do ALOT of work.

After memorizing every bit of information prior to the final, I felt like I was 100% ready. I knew how to work every single problem out of the 8 practice tests given throughout the year.  I sat down to take the test and found that I couldn't obtain an answer for almost half the questions.  She loves questions that can trick you in 50 different ways

It wasn't an interesting class and the online homework was a pain but nevertheless i learned a lot and it didn't take too much studying. she has a ton of office hours & actually makes sure you understand the answer to your question. Her exams were a little hard, and there are a lot of quizzes, but she only count 9 quizzes and drops the lowest exam!

best prof i have had so far!! she is super nice and her tests aren't too difficult as long as u go to class and take the practice tests online. also the OWL homeworks and clicker points really help ur grade!

People will tell you her class is hard but chemistry isn't an easy subject. Out of all the chem profs shes the best. She doesn't have the best way of explaining things but she has a buttload of office hours that will help you out. Be sure to attend class because she gives quizzes (their easy). You take a total of 17ish but she only counts 9.

A lot of people told me to get this prof because she was the easiest.  Well they were WRONG!  I did not like her class- random quizzes, OWL hw, boring lectures, hard & TRICKY tests. She acts like she will curve, but it only ends up being one or two test questions for the entire semester.  I would recommend a different prof for this class.

Everyone told me to take her for chem. but I really didn't enjoy her. She doesn't really teach. She just kinda stands up there and talks and talks to the point where it gets so boring that you stop paying attention.  Her tests try and trick you. They are very poorly worded. Overall I would say find another professor to take.
Very nice and helpful.  Her test questions count alot, but she usually has some way to make up for it.  I love her corny jokes.

Very good instructor and has pop quizzes at least once a week to make sure you're actually learning/reading the material. She takes the best 9 grades. Few multiple choice questions ( averaging 14-16) which unforunately counts alot and free responses ( easier ).Tests can be a little confusing.  Don't skip this class!
